evals.prompt: Làm giúp mình video showcase cho tính năng Board của Anywhere (kanban tickets): tạo một ticket mới rồi giao cho agent chạy, ticket tự chuyển cột khi agent làm xong. Lần này chỉ cần storyboard theo beat, timeline, và 3 still của các màn chính để mình duyệt hướng, chưa render full video.
evals.expected_output: A Remotion project outside the repo with a beat storyboard of one continuous flow, a timeline.json for it, and three Window stills in Graphite Dark rebuilt from source and gated against dark captures from the fake pocketd.
assertions: The Remotion project is outside the repo (~/video/...) and no tracked file in the repo changed
storyboard.md describes one continuous in-app flow (no cuts inside the app window) with beat numbers, 30–40s total
The timeline file sets about 128 BPM and lists clicks and typing runs that drive both picture and sound
All three stills are Graphite Dark (mean luma under 60) and show the Board feature's screens
The UI is rebuilt from source: colours from theme.rs dark tokens and icons from the app's icon set, not screenshots placed as images
Session and ticket labels are real titles (fixture or realistic), not branch names
Reference screens came from the fake pocketd via verify-anywhere (evidence under .ui-review/shots/verify), not real repos
No full-length video or 4K render was produced
